explanation: IsDiameter2Critical requires diam = 2 and that deleting any edge makes diam ≠ 2. Since deleting edges cannot shrink distances, this means the diameter increases or the graph disconnects (Mathlib diam = 0). That matches erdosproblems.com/742. The variant asserts the Murty–Simon bound |E| ≤ ⌊n²/4⌋ for n ≤ 24 and n = 26, attributed to Fan [Fa87]. This matches the standard account of Fan's verification; the erdosproblems page does not list it. Faithful.
